title: Files component data
description: File list. Lists uploaded files in items. Agents cannot add files: an item needs a storageId from a file upload, which MCP does not offer, so items is read-only for agents. Run-mode behaviour is set by allowAddInRunMode, allowDeleteInRunMode and layout.

items.description: The uploaded files, each per $defs/item. Read-only for agents: an item needs a storageId from a file upload, which MCP does not offer.

allowAddInRunMode.description: When true, members may add files in run mode. App default true.

allowDeleteInRunMode.description: When true, members may delete files in run mode. Also gates editing captions. App default false.

maxVisibleItems.description: Maximum number of files shown. 0 means unlimited. Example: 6.

layout.description: How files are displayed: grid or list.

_title.description: Panel title shown above the component. '' clears it. Example: "Groceries".

_sectionBreak.description: true starts a new visual section, with a bigger gap above and a stronger separator.

_width.description: Preferred width in logical pixels. Default 600, minimum 300.

_spaceAbove.description: Legacy spacing above in pixels, no longer written. When _sectionBreak is absent, a value of 16 or more reads as a section break.

_spaceBelow.description: Legacy spacing below in pixels, no longer written.

^_.description: Other layout and UI keys starting with _. Any value.

storageId.description: Id of the uploaded file in storage. Comes from a file upload.

index.description: Sort position among the files, lower first.

filename.description: Original file name, or null. Example: "report.pdf".

sizeBytes.description: File size in bytes, or null.
